valuation_template_rationale: Tesla combines a profitable but cyclical automotive-and-services base, a growing energy segment and pre-profit or economically undisclosed autonomy, robotics and AI optionality; the other template with a sum-of-parts method is the only repository-owned template that can separate those components while making net cash, debt, dilution and capital intensity explicit.
bear_assumptions: Three times annualized Q2 automotive-and-services revenue, four times annualized energy revenue, USD 100 billion of AI-enabled option value and USD 34.444 billion net cash; demand or margins weaken, capital spending stays above cash conversion, and autonomy and robotics do not establish material profit pools.
base_assumptions: Four-and-one-half times annualized Q2 automotive-and-services revenue, six times annualized energy revenue, USD 400 billion of AI-enabled option value and USD 34.444 billion net cash; scale and energy growth persist, but operating leverage improves gradually and AI economics remain promising rather than mature.
bull_assumptions: Six times annualized Q2 automotive-and-services revenue, eight times annualized energy revenue, USD 1 trillion of AI-enabled option value and USD 34.444 billion net cash; vehicle margins recover, energy compounds with durable margins, and autonomy or robotics reaches safe commercial scale with demonstrable cash economics.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only after supported component economics or a lower market price clears the canonical expected-return, base-upside, payoff and margin-of-safety gates; downgrade if vehicle demand, margins, cash conversion, autonomy execution, capital productivity, governance or liquidity deteriorates.
